words.english: as a courtesy (= as a favor)
words.chinese: 作為禮貌（的表示），出於好意
words.example: As a courtesy, we offer complimentary coffee and tea to all our guests.

words.chinese: 依據要求；如所請求
words.example: Your invoice, as requested, is attached to this email.

words.english: at no charge (= at no cost)
words.chinese: 免費的；不收取任何費用
words.example: We offer free consultations at no charge to potential clients.

words.chinese: 免費的；不收取額外費用
words.example: We offer complimentary Wi-Fi access to all guests at no extra charge.

words.chinese: 專心處理客戶的需求或問題；悉心照料客戶
words.example: Our staff is trained to attend to clients promptly and efficiently.

words.chinese: 理賠部門；負責處理客戶索賠的部門
words.example: Please submit all insurance claims to the claims department for processing.

words.chinese: 抱怨；投訴（通常指對產品、服務或情況的不滿）
words.example: We've received several complaints about the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 投訴；抱怨（通常指正式的、書面的投訴）
words.example: We received several complaints regarding the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 免費提供的；作為贈送的（常用於形容免費的服務或產品）
words.example: The hotel offers a complimentary shuttle service to the airport for all guests.

words.chinese: 客戶意見調查；顧客滿意度調查
words.example: We conduct customer surveys regularly to improve our services.

words.chinese: 顧客；客戶
words.example: Our priority is to provide excellent service to our customers.

words.chinese: 令人失望的；未達預期的
words.example: The sales figures for this quarter were disappointing, falling short of our projections.

words.chinese: 不滿意；對某事物的負面感受或意見，通常與期望未達而產生。
words.example: The company is addressing customer dissatisfaction regarding the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 不滿意；對品質或服務感到失望
words.example: The client expressed dissatisfaction with the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 使不滿意；使不滿足
words.example: The company's slow response time began to dissatisfy many customers.

words.chinese: 令人不滿意的；未達標的
words.example: The customer complained that the product's performance was dissatisfying.

words.chinese: 後續跟進；追蹤處理
words.example: We'll send a follow-up email to confirm your order details.

words.chinese: 免費的；不收取費用的
words.example: We offer complimentary Wi-Fi access to all our guests, free of charge.

words.chinese: 保證；確保；有…的保障
words.example: The company guarantees a 100% satisfaction rate for all its products.

words.chinese: 專線；熱線（通常指提供資訊、諮詢或協助的電話服務）
words.example: Our customer service hotline is available 24/7 for all your inquiries.

words.chinese: 詢問、提問（通常指正式的、書面的詢問）
words.example: We received several inquiries regarding the new product's features.

words.chinese: 提出投訴；抱怨（服務、產品等）
words.example: The customer decided to make a complaint about the delayed shipment.

words.chinese: 破例；做出特殊安排
words.example: I understand the usual policy is no refunds, but I'm willing to make an exception for you given the circumstances.

words.chinese: 不設例外；絕對不允許
words.example: Our policy is strict; we make no exception for late payments.

words.chinese: 以過高的價格收費；收取過高的費用
words.example: The taxi driver was accused of overcharging the tourists.

words.chinese: 各個年齡層的人們；涵蓋所有年齡層的顧客/員工
words.example: Our new product is designed to appeal to people of all ages.

words.chinese: 評等；評分；評價等級
words.example: The hotel received excellent ratings for its cleanliness and service.

words.chinese: 評分；評級；評價
words.example: The online store relies heavily on customer ratings to attract new buyers.

words.chinese: 前台接待員；負責迎接訪客、接聽電話及處理一般行政事務的工作人員
words.example: The receptionist scheduled the conference room for the meeting at 10 a.m.

words.chinese: 建議；推薦（通常是正式的或書面的意見）
words.example: The hotel received positive recommendations for its excellent service and convenient location.

words.chinese: 退款；退費
words.example: Customers are entitled to full refunds if the product is defective.

words.chinese: 回報問題；通報狀況
words.example: Please report any technical problems to the IT support team immediately.

words.chinese: 已解決的；已決定的；堅定的（形容詞）／解決（動詞的過去式與過去分詞）
words.example: The technical support team resolved the network outage within two hours.

words.chinese: 對產品、服務或結果感到滿意；符合需求或期望的狀態
words.example: The client was satisfied with the delivery schedule we proposed.

words.chinese: 為顧客提供服務；接待顧客
words.example: Our staff is trained to serve customers efficiently and courteously.

words.chinese: 服務；（公司提供的）一系列活動或功能，以滿足客戶需求。
words.example: Our company offers a wide range of financial services to meet the needs of our clients.

words.chinese: 指場地內可容納的站立人數，通常指沒有座位的情況下可供站立的空間。
words.example: Due to the popularity of the event, there is only standing room available.

words.chinese: 款待；對待（某人或某事），通常指以特定的方式或態度處理。
words.example: The company treated its valued clients to a VIP experience at the industry conference.

words.chinese: 拒絕接待；轉走（顧客、訪客等）；將…轉向別處
words.example: Due to the high volume of visitors, the security guard had to turn away several people without appointments.

words.chinese: 不可接受的；不符合要求的
words.example: The quality of the delivered goods was unacceptable, and we require a full refund.

words.chinese: 在保固期內；符合保固條款
words.example: The printer is still under warranty, so we can repair it for free.

words.chinese: 未達標的；令人不滿意的
words.example: The customer complained that the product's performance was unsatisfactory.

words.chinese: 不滿意；未被滿足的
words.example: The client expressed that he was unsatisfied with the delayed delivery.

words.chinese: 非常重要的人 (VIP)；尊貴的顧客或會員，通常享有特殊待遇。
words.example: Our hotel offers exclusive amenities and personalized service for all VIP guests.

words.chinese: 放棄（權利、費用等）；免除
words.example: The hotel can waive the cancellation fee if you provide sufficient notice.
